query: SELECT (SELECT m.name FROM agent_team_members m JOIN idempotency i ON i.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND i.execution_status = 'queued' WHERE m.team_id = $1 AND m.workspace = 'my_files' AND m.state NOT IN ('stopped', 'done') AND NOT (m.state = 'failed' AND NOT m.failed_run) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_instances s WHERE s.conversation_id = m.conversation_id) ORDER BY i.ordinal LIMIT 1) AS files, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i JOIN conversations c ON c.id = i.conversation_id WHERE i.execution_status = 'queued' AND c.state = 'active' AND i.conversation_id <> $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_instances s WHERE s.conversation_id = i.conversation_id)) AS "slot!"
